course.id AS c_id, course.course_id AS c_course_id, course.title AS c_title, course.detail AS c_detail, course.class_room_id AS c_class_room_id, course.course_term AS c_course_term, course.tuition_fee AS c_tuition_fee, course.material_fee AS c_material_fee, course.registered_at AS c_registered_at, course.updated_at AS c_updated_at,

mapper.select:
select DISTINCT
FROM course
join course_capacity on course.course_id= course_capacity.course_id
join class_room on course.class_room_id= class_room.id
join class_room_schedule on course.course_id = class_room_schedule.course_id
order by c_course_id,s_date,s_start_time

select
FROM course

join class_room on course.class_room_id= class_room.id
join class_room_schedule on course.course_id = class_room_schedule.course_id
join( SELECT course_id FROM course ORDER BY course_id limit #{offset},#{limit} ) as limited_course on course.course_id=limited_course.course_id
